title: OFFICE REVOLT
subtitle: FIFTEEN MINUTES. CHAIR. WALL. STAIRS. MOVE.
intro: RIGHT YOU MAGNIFICENT SLUG. THE WALK DOES NOT COUNT AS THIS. THIS IS FIFTEEN MINUTES FOR THE SPINE, THE HIPS, AND THAT CHAIR YOU MARRIED. PHONE DOWN. STAND UP. WE ARE WORKING.
completion: THAT IS THE LOT. YOU DID NOT DIE. WATER. THEN SIT DOWN LIKE A HUMAN WITH A BACK, NOT A PRAWN. I WILL BE BACK TOMORROW.

exercises.name: MARCH ON THE SPOT
exercises.instruction: SIXTY SECONDS. KNEE UP. ARMS PUMPING. YOU ARE NOT A PALM TREE. GET THE BLOOD MOVING.
exercises.midCue: HIGHER. I CAN STILL SEE YOU NEGOTIATING WITH GRAVITY.
exercises.endCue: TIME. KEEP STANDING. THE CHAIR IS NOT YOUR FRIEND.
exercises.restCue: TWENTY SECONDS. BREATHE THROUGH YOUR NOSE. WALL IS NEXT.

exercises.name: WALL ANGELS
exercises.instruction: FORTY-FIVE SECONDS. BACK ON THE WALL. HEAD, ARSE, AND SHOULDERS TOUCHING. SLIDE THE ARMS UP AND DOWN LIKE YOU ARE MAKING SNOW ANGELS AND THE WALL IS JUDGING YOU.
exercises.midCue: KEEP THE CONTACT. IF YOUR RIBS FLARE I SHALL BE DISAPPOINTED AND LOUD.
exercises.endCue: ARMS DOWN. STEP OFF THE WALL.
exercises.restCue: TWENTY. STAIRS OR A STURDY CHAIR. INCLINE PUSH-UPS.

exercises.name: INCLINE PUSH-UPS
exercises.instruction: EIGHT PUSH-UPS. HANDS ON A STAIR OR THE CHAIR SEAT. BODY IN A STRAIGHT LINE. LOWER THE CHEST. KNEES ARE LEGAL. HALF-REPS ARE NOT.
exercises.completeCue: THAT WILL DO. ON YOUR FEET. DO NOT COLLAPSE INTO THE FURNITURE.

exercises.name: CHAIR SIT-TO-STANDS
exercises.instruction: TEN. SIT DOWN WITH CONTROL. STAND UP WITHOUT USING YOUR HANDS IF YOU CAN. IF YOU NEED THE ARMRESTS, USE THEM AND DO NOT APOLOGISE TO ME.
exercises.completeCue: GOOD. HIPS STILL ATTACHED. LUCKY YOU.
exercises.restCue: TWENTY-FIVE. FLOOR. BIRD DOG. YES IT LOOKS SILLY. DO IT ANYWAY.

exercises.name: BIRD DOG
exercises.instruction: FIFTY SECONDS. ON ALL FOURS. OPPOSITE ARM AND OPPOSITE LEG. SLOW. HIPS LEVEL. IF YOU WOBBLE THAT IS THE POINT, NOT A PERSONAL FAILING.
exercises.midCue: SWITCH SIDES. STILL SLOW. THIS IS NOT A RACE WITH A SPANIEL.
exercises.endCue: KNEES DOWN. WELL DONE YOU ODD LITTLE AEROPLANE.
exercises.restCue: TWENTY SECONDS. CHAIR IN REACH. BALANCE.

exercises.name: SINGLE-LEG STAND
exercises.instruction: FORTY SECONDS. TWENTY A SIDE. HOLD THE CHAIR. STAND ON ONE FOOT. SOFT KNEE. EYES ON SOMETHING THAT IS NOT YOUR PHONE.
exercises.midCue: SWITCH LEGS. STILL HOLDING THE CHAIR. HEROICS CAN WAIT A MONTH.
exercises.endCue: BOTH FEET. THAT IS BALANCE, NOT BALLET.
exercises.restCue: TWENTY. ON YOUR BACK. GLUTE BRIDGES. YES, YOUR ARSE. IT HAS A JOB.

exercises.name: GLUTE BRIDGES
exercises.instruction: TWELVE. FEET ON THE FLOOR. LIFT THE HIPS. SQUEEZE AT THE TOP LIKE YOU ARE HOLDING A TENNER BETWEEN THE CHEEKS AND I AM NOT PAYING YOU TO DROP IT.
exercises.completeCue: ENOUGH THEATRE. ROLL TO YOUR SIDE AND GET UP.
exercises.restCue: TWENTY. LAST ONE. KNEE PLANK. THEN YOU MAY GO BACK TO YOUR PRECIOUS COMPUTER.

exercises.name: KNEE PLANK
exercises.instruction: THIRTY SECONDS. KNEES DOWN. STRAIGHT LINE FROM SHOULDERS TO KNEES. HIPS ARE NOT A HAMMOCK. BREATHE.
exercises.midCue: STILL A LINE. I AM WATCHING THE HIPS.
exercises.endCue: DOWN. CAREFULLY. THAT IS THE WORK.
